description:
To investigate the luxury cruise ship Utopia, Dorothy heads to the surface.
She's packed plenty of supplies, as if expecting something.
But the investigation mission itself seems to be a low priority for her, as she clearly has her own agenda.

lines.text:
Why that look?
Does seeing me in this outfit surprise you?

I will opt out of swimming.
I cannot bear the idea of my clothes getting wet.
I sincerely hope I can find it here.
Hehe, today is truly a joyous day, for I can be with you.

Come and join me, if you would.
I was just about to pour myself some tea.

This is a parasol which I am rather fond of. 
What do you think of it?

The sunlight is quite intense here,
so I hope you won't keep me waiting for too long.

Enjoying some tea with a change of scenery isn't so bad, I suppose.
All the same, please do hurry back.

The air is incredibly stuffy here. 
Let's leave quickly once you are finished.
There's a place here that sells parasols?

Marigold... It's been a while.
Someone once roasted and brewed it for me a long time ago.
Somehow, I have an auspicious premonition that I might meet her today.
That is a wise judgment. I will prove it by showing you the results.
I shall ensure you do not regret placing your trust in me.

Are you still uneasy? 
Then I suppose I have no choice but to show you precisely what I'm capable of.
Did I mention that I was fond of this?
Given your sincerity, I shall accept it gracefully.
If the opportunity arises, I shall repay you.
Your behavior is always a subject of fascination for me, Your Grace.

You are quite fortunate. 
I was just preparing some high-grade tea. Would you care for a taste?
From here on out, I shall keep watch over you.
As it's a rare occasion, I shall take the lead.
You called?
I shall proceed in that direction.
Let's go.
What is there to be concerned about when I am around?
It has been quite some time since I felt such pleasant emotions.
We will not be defeated by anyone now.
One moment. I must reload.
It is reassuring to have you by my side.
I absolutely detest becoming unclean.
Are you suggesting we attempt this now?
Stop, it's cold... Heh, it's really cold!
Now! Push through to the very end!
That was easy.
Didn't I tell you not to worry?
It has concluded.
Agh!
Tsk.
Ugh!
I had hoped to spend a little more time together...
Hehe, now we can finally get back to spending time together, just the two of us.
